hints.title: Substitution Alphabet Mapping
hints.text: Map each novel lowercase letter encountered in the key sequentially to English letters from 'a' to 'z'.

hints.title: Preserving Layout
hints.text: Space characters in the message must remain spaces without transformation.

hints.title: Lookup Table Construction
hints.text: Traverse the key once, building a dictionary mapping each unseen non-space character to chr(ord('a') + len(mapping)).

hints.title: Sequential Hash Table Implementation

complexity.notes: Alphabet size is fixed at 26 characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning key repeatedly for each message character yields O(m * n) runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed-size hash map provides O(1) character translation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains an ordered substitution map correctly preserving spaces.
